in_hebrew.name: ברטרם
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ברטרם מקורו בשפה העברית ומשמעותו בן רם, בנו של רם. רם הוא שם עברי שפירושו גבוה, מרומם. השם ברטרם נמצא בשימוש בעיקר במסגרת השמות הנוצריים, והוא קשור קשר הדוק למסורת הנוצרית האנגלית.

in_greek.name: Βαρترام
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Βαρترام προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σημαίνει υιος του Ραμ. Ο Ραμ είναι εβραϊκό όνομα που σημαίνει υψηλός, ανυψωμένος. Το όνομα Βαρترام χρησιμοποιείται κυρίως στο πλαίσιο των χριστιανικών ονομάτων και συνδέεται στενά με την αγγλική χριστιανική παράδοση.

in_english.name: Bartram
in_english.long_meaning: The name Bartram originates from Hebrew roots, specifically meaning 'son of Ram'. Ram translates to 'bright' or 'elevated', suggesting a person of high status or fame. Historically, Bartram has been associated with Christian traditions, particularly in England, where it was popularized as a given name and surname. The name carries spiritual significance, implying a connection to divine favor or elevation. In modern usage, Bartram remains a distinctive name within Christian cultures, symbolizing heritage and faith.

data.cultural_impact: The name Bartram holds a significant cultural impact, particularly in American history. The most notable figure with this name is John Bartram (1699-1777), who was an influential botanist and explorer in colonial America. He is credited with discovering over 300 plant species new to science, many of which are still in use today. Bartram helped establish the scientific study of American flora and fauna, and his expedition records were crucial in the founding of the first botanic garden in North America.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Bartram also holds spiritual significance, reflecting the connection between humanity and the natural world. The Old English origin of the name, meaning 'son of the earth', corresponds to the biblical concept of stewardship over God's creation. This spiritual theme is reflected in the life and work of John Bartram, who explored and documented the natural world with a deep sense of awe and reverence for the Creator. The name Bartram, therefore, serves as a reminder of our role as caretakers of the earth and our responsibility to preserve and protect the natural world for future generations.
